title: Focused screenshot selection
responsibility: Select revision-bound focused images and class audio, preserving original provenance, failure outcomes and source-tree identity without granting a full verification verdict.

inputs.name: focusedCaptures.detail
inputs.description: Stored revision with exact-commit captures or validated whole-tree identity. Entity projections carry an opaque sourceTree hash; raw prepared history may use its legacy side locator. A different tree is rejected.

inputs.name: focusedCaptures.unit
inputs.description: Registered owner identifier for focused images or class-generated audio; another unit never fills a missing artifact.

inputs.name: focusedScenario.sides
inputs.description: Selected commit and first-parent evidence, retaining the union of their focused states and viewport declarations.

inputs.name: focusedScenario.unit
inputs.description: Unit whose focused gallery is described independently of full-verification scenario coverage.

outputs.name: focusedCaptures
outputs.description: Newest image per state and viewport; class audio stays distinct per bound case, evidence slot and state. Require exact unit, revision and media hash binding. Preserve original tested revision, run outcome and provenance; audio needs no HTTP server or screenshot viewport. Identical-tree reuse grants no full verdict.

outputs.name: focusedScenario
outputs.description: Focused screenshot declarations for usable images and their original states and viewports. Audio-only evidence yields no visual scenario or invented viewport.
